task: understand how the problem reporting and management system is expected to work, identify main user types, main goals, and functionality relationships
target: municipal problem reporting and management system
goal: gain a high-level understanding of the system's architecture, user roles, and core functionalities without knowing the specific details yet
constraints: specific user roles are not yet known
functionalities available to each user role are not yet known
source_goal: I am a business analyst. I need to understand at a high level how a system for reporting and managing problems in a municipal area is expected to work. I know that the application should allow people to report issues in the territory and support the municipality in managing them, but I do not yet know the specific user roles or the functionalities available to each of them. I need to identify the main types of users that interact with the system, the main goals they can achieve through it, and how the different functionalities are related to each other.
